```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
library(readr)
breeding_site_locations <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
migratory_connectivity_dataset <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
```
```{r}
glimpse(breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
print(nrow(breeding_site_locations))
print(ncol(breeding_site_locations))
print(dim(breeding_site_locations))
```
```{r}
gt(head(migratory_connectivity_dataset))
```

```{r}
glimpse(migratory_connectivity_dataset)
print(nrow(migratory_connectivity_dataset))
print(ncol(migratory_connectivity_dataset))
print(dim(migratory_connectivity_dataset))

```
```{r}
selected_breeding_site_locations <- breeding_site_locations |> 
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> 
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)
gt(selected_breeding_site_locations)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- migratory_connectivity_dataset |> 
  select(Site, winterLongitude, winterLatitude, pslon, pslat, iblon, iblat, awestlon, awestlat) |> 
  distinct() |>
  rename(Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude, 
         Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
         Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
         Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
         Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
         Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
         Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
         Westmost_Latitude = awestlat)
gt(bird_migration_selected)


breeding_site_locations_exc <- breeding_site_locations |> filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(breeding_site_locations_exc)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_selected |> 
  group_by(Site) |> 
  summarise (Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- selected_breeding_site_locations |> 
  filter(Site!= "Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
```

```{r}
bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |> 
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(head(bird_migration_exc))
```
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- combined_bird_data |> 
  filter(Site != "Spain")
gt(combined_bird_data)
```



```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |> 
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data, 
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude))+ 
    geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap()

```




```{r}
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lon)

max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lon)

min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

print(min_lat)

max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

print(max_lat)

ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2))

ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
) +
  geom_point() +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
```


```{r}
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  )
```
